# 2 Chronicles Chapter 34 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Son-of eight years was-Josiah in-his-reigning and-thirty-and-one years he-reigned in-Jerusalem.

**2** And-he-did the-right in-eyes-of YHWH and-he-walked in-ways-of David his-father and-not he-turned right or-left.

**3** And-in-year eight of-his-reign and-he still a-youth he-began to-seek God-of David his-father and-in-year twelve he-began to-purify Judah and-Jerusalem from the-high-places and-the-Asherim and-the-images and-the-molten-images.

**4** And-they-tore-down before-him altars-of the-Baals and-the-incense-altars that were-above upon-them he-cut-down and-the-Asherim and-the-images and-the-molten-images he-broke and-he-ground and-he-scattered on graves-of the-sacrificers to-them.

**5** And-bones-of priests he-burned on their-altars and-he-purified Judah and-Jerusalem.

**6** And-in-cities-of Manasseh and-Ephraim and-Simeon and-to Naphtali in-their-ruins all-around.

**7** And-he-tore-down the-altars and-the-Asherim and-the-images he-beat to-grinding and-all the-incense-altars he-cut-down in-all land-of Israel and-he-returned to-Jerusalem.

**8** And-in-year eighteen of-his-reign to-purify the-land and-the-house he-sent Shaphan son-of Azaliah and-Maaseiah ruler-of the-city and-Joah son-of Joahaz the-recorder to-repair house-of YHWH his-God.

**9** And-they-came to Hilkiah the-priest the-great and-they-gave the-silver the-brought to-house-of God that gathered the-Levites keepers-of the-threshold from-Manasseh and-Ephraim and-from-all remnant-of Israel and-from-all Judah and-Benjamin and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem.

**10** And-they-gave on hand-of doers-of the-work the-appointed in-house-of YHWH and-they-gave-it doers-of the-work who worked in-house-of YHWH to-repair and-to-strengthen the-house.

**11** And-they-gave to-the-craftsmen and-to-the-builders to-buy stones-of hewn and-wood for-joists and-to-beam the-houses that destroyed kings-of Judah.

**12** And-the-men were-doing in-the-work in-faithfulness and-over-them were-appointed Jahath and-Obadiah the-Levites from-sons-of Merari and-Zechariah and-Meshullam from-sons-of the-Kohathites to-oversee and-the-Levites all understanding in-instruments-of song.

**13** And-over the-burden-bearers and-overseeing all doers-of work for-service and-service and-from-the-Levites scribes and-officers and-gatekeepers.

**14** And-as-they-were-bringing-out the-silver the-brought to-house-of YHWH found Hilkiah the-priest book-of law-of YHWH by-hand-of Moses.

**15** And-he-answered Hilkiah and-he-said to Shaphan the-scribe book-of the-law I-found in-house-of YHWH and-he-gave Hilkiah the-book to Shaphan.

**16** And-he-brought Shaphan the-book to the-king and-he-returned still the-king a-word saying all that was-given in-hand-of your-servants they are-doing.

**17** And-they-poured-out the-silver the-found in-house-of YHWH and-they-gave-it on hand-of the-appointed and-on hand-of doers-of the-work.

**18** And-he-told Shaphan the-scribe to-the-king saying a-book gave to-me Hilkiah the-priest and-he-read in-it Shaphan before the-king.

**19** And-it-was as-heard the-king words-of the-law and-he-tore his-garments.

**20** And-he-commanded the-king Hilkiah and-Ahikam son-of Shaphan and-Abdon son-of Micah and-Shaphan the-scribe and-Asaiah servant-of the-king saying

**21** go seek YHWH for-me and-for the-remaining in-Israel and-in-Judah concerning words-of the-book that was-found for great is-wrath-of YHWH that is-poured-out against-us because not kept our-fathers word-of YHWH to-do according-to-all the-written in-this book.

**22** And-she-went Hilkiah and-those-of the-king to Huldah the-prophetess wife-of Shallum son-of Tokhath son-of Hasrah keeper-of the-garments and-she was-dwelling in-Jerusalem in-the-Second-Quarter and-they-spoke to-her according-to-this.

**23** And-she-said to-them thus says YHWH God-of Israel say to-the-man who sent you to-me.

**24** Thus says YHWH behold-Me bringing evil on this place and-on its-inhabitants all the-curses the-written on the-book that they-read before king-of Judah.

**25** Because that they-forsook-Me and-they-burned-incense to-gods other so-as-to-provoke-Me with-all works-of their-hands and-it-will-pour-out My-wrath on this place and-not it-will-be-quenched.

**26** And-to king-of Judah the-sending-you to-seek YHWH thus you-shall-say to-him thus says YHWH God-of Israel the-words that you-heard

**27** because was-tender your-heart and-you-humbled-yourself before God in-your-hearing His-words against this place and-against its-inhabitants and-you-humbled-yourself before-Me and-you-tore your-garments and-you-wept before-Me and-also I I-heard declares-YHWH.

**28** Behold-Me gathering-you to your-fathers and-you-shall-be-gathered to your-graves in-peace and-not shall-see your-eyes all the-evil that I am-bringing on this place and-on its-inhabitants and-they-returned the-king the-word.

**29** And-he-sent the-king and-he-gathered all elders-of Judah and-Jerusalem.

**30** And-he-went-up the-king to-house-of YHWH and-all men-of Judah and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem and-the-priests and-the-Levites and-all the-people from-great and-to small and-he-read in-their-ears all words-of book-of the-covenant the-found in-house-of YHWH.

**31** And-he-stood the-king on his-place and-he-cut the-covenant before YHWH to-walk after YHWH and-to-keep His-commandments and-His-testimonies and-His-statutes with-all his-heart and-with-all his-soul to-do words-of the-covenant the-written on this book.

**32** And-he-made-stand all who-were-found in-Jerusalem and-Benjamin and-they-did inhabitants-of Jerusalem according-to-covenant-of God God-of their-fathers.

**33** And-he-removed Josiah all the-abominations from-all the-lands that were-for-sons-of Israel and-he-made all who-were-found in-Israel to-serve to-serve YHWH their-God all his-days not they-turned from-after YHWH God-of their-fathers.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **34:3**: in-year eight...he-began to-seek — Josiah's reform begins at age sixteen with personal devotion, four years before the public purge begins. Internal transformation precedes external reform.

- **34:14**: book-of law-of YHWH — The discovery of the Torah scroll is the catalyst for the deepest reform in Judah's history. The written word has explosive power when it encounters a responsive heart.

- **34:27**: was-tender your-heart — The Hebrew rakh (tender/soft) describes a heart responsive to God's word. Josiah's tears are the mark of genuine repentance.


— EMET
